svg.title: Thiosulfate is a finite reaction budget
svg.desc: Inside the leaching vessel, thiosulfate is a fixed charge. Oxygen from a controlled supply above the vessel helps thiosulfate dissolve gold from crushed circuit board, which carries far more copper than gold. Copper leaves the board as copper(I); oxygen re-oxidises it to copper(II), which converts thiosulfate into tetrathionate and returns to copper(I). The copper is regenerated on every turn and the thiosulfate is not, so the leachant runs out while gold is still on the board.
